name: Sushant
text:
We had an absolutely wonderful stay! We booked the property at the very last minute, on the same day we were travelling, and the host was incredibly accommodating and helpful. Since we couldn’t check in at our original time, the host even offered us a late checkout, which was such a thoughtful gesture.

We were there to celebrate my sister’s birthday, and the property made the experience even more special. The place had everything we needed, was incredibly spacious, and every little corner was beautifully designed. The colours on the walls, the decor, and the overall aesthetic were just amazing. You could tell a lot of thought and love had gone into creating the space.

We truly appreciated the host’s kindness, flexibility, and hospitality. We had a lovely experience and would absolutely love to come back. Highly recommend! ❤️

name: Harsh
text: We had a great stay at this Airbnb with our group of 16 for 3 nights! The house was a perfect fit for our group, with plenty of space for everyone to relax and enjoy themselves. There were lots of activities available at the house to keep everyone entertained throughout our stay, which made the experience even more fun and enjoyable. We had a wonderful time together, made great memories, and truly appreciated the space and amenities. We would definitely recommend this place to other large groups looking for a fun and relaxing getaway!

name: Tanya
text:
This was a wonderful place for all my friends to stay for the weekend. It had spacious bedrooms with plenty of bathrooms that were well stocked with linens and all the toiletries. Plenty to do in terms of activities for the kids - they loved the outdoor play space and the indoor game room and movie theater. Large spacious kitchen with plenty of room, pots and pans. The host was very communicative. The only thing was that a DoorDash driver came
To drop off batteries late at 9pm and the driver was being very sketchy and not leaving, there was no communication from the host re delivery. The DoorDash driver came back the next day and then we asked the host about it. Just was a little worrisome the way the driver acted made us nervous and would have liked a heads up. Other than that was a lovely place to stay and the fire pit hot tub and sauna were amazing!

name: Matt
text: This was an incredible place for us. Hosted our large family with plenty of space and entertainment. All our guests talked about how the place was perfect for entertaining. We catered in dinner that could host all 20 people. Lots of character in this house and we all talked about coming back again. Edward was great to work with, informative and quick to respond. Would come back again

name: Rupangi
text:
Overall it was a great house and great location
Entertainment for all the age groups
Great family weekend gateway with little kids

name: Shmuel
text:
Eddie was a fantastic host very responsive, helpful, and easy to communicate with throughout the stay.

We had an amazing stay! The property was perfect for us, and the amenities were an absolute blast. The kids especially loved it! they couldn’t get enough of all the games and activities, and there was always something fun for everyone to do.

The house was comfortable, peaceful, and really gave us the relaxing and family getaway we were looking for.

We would definitely love to come back! Highly recommend! ⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️

name: Wei
text:
We had such a great stay here with our group. The house is very spacious and works really well for a large group, but it still feels comfortable and welcoming. Bedrooms were comfortable, clean, and beautifully decorated, and everyone had their own space to relax.

There are so many things to do at the property that we didn’t feel the need to leave. The baseball batting cage was such a unique feature and something we had never seen at an Airbnb before. The pickleball court was also a big hit, and the kids loved having their own playground.

The hot tub and sauna were perfect for relaxing at the end of the day. Between the outdoor activities, games, and all of the different amenities, there was really something for everyone, both adults and kids.

The whole property feels more like a private mini resort than a regular vacation rental. It’s a great place for a large family gathering or a trip with a big group of friends. We had a wonderful time and would definitely stay here again.

name: Andre
text: Peaceful weekend facilitated by Eddie and his professionalism, responsiveness, and willingness to assist. Lovely house with a lot to offer especially for a large group such as hours.

name: Yinghua
text: Our family had a great time there, the place is clean and had a lot of amazing places near by, great location and our kids had a great time in the house.

name: Paromita
text: Wiki villa stay was super fun! We had 8 adults and 8 kids and the house was big enough for everyone to stay comfortably for a week! The kids had tons to do, lot of space to run around and with hiking trails and water activities nearby, the location of the villa is great. There were few minor issues but Edward took care of them promptly. He is very helpful and super responsive. We enjoyed our stay at wiki villa!

name: Kelly
text:
We had a great stay at Wiki Cabin. This is a huge place with plenty of room for our party of 12! We really loved that there was ample seating for everyone to share large meals together, either indoor or outdoor.

There were so many different activities and amenities - the outdoor pool, sauna, brand-new pickleball court, and pool table were real standouts for us.

To top it all off, Eddie was very proactive and responsive in communications, making it a very easy experience. We would definitely come back!

name: Shannon
text:
We had a fun stay here. The property has an impressive number of unique amenities. The pool and slide, pool table, and sauna made the house especially entertaining, and the interior decorating was creative and cool. A lot of thought that went into making this a memorable space.
That said, the overall condition didn’t quite match the “luxe” description. Some of the basic upkeep and maintenance were lacking. The grill was dirty and had a broken lid, so we weren’t able to use it. The "diving" platform had rotting boards. There were also boxes and packaging stored behind the outdoor bar, which made the area feel cramped, and a furniture delivery arrived while we were staying. The included toiletries were very thin, almost as though they had been diluted with water.
None of these issues prevented us from having a good time—some of the less exciting but important basics of maintenance and readiness needed more attention. With those things addressed, this could be a truly exceptional property

name: Aram
text: Eddie was supper host, place is big, plenty rooms to stay with big company, big pool , 2 refrigerators, big kitchen, nice outdoor fire pit, hot tub, plenty of parking space for 12+ car. Game room with poker table and poll . We enjoyed a lot and . And will definitely come back!

name: Joselin
text: We had an amazing stay, the home was beautiful and very cozy. I highly recommend! There was something to do for every one! It was great, Eddie was also very attentive and available.

name: Hanford
text: This property is ideal for family reunions - full of activities for families with kids to enjoy together. The large lawn provided perfect terrain for kids sports, and as the listing mentions - built-in indoor and outdoor group activities that kept us all busy this past weekend, eg. pool table, pool, hot tub, and treat for adults - nice clean sauna. Can’t say enough about Eddie’s responsiveness when we had minor questions at the start and end of our stay.

name: Sandra
text:
Hello Everyone,

My Family and I had a wonderful week at Edward’s place it was phenomenal. There was lots to do in the house whenever our bodies were tired of swimming in the pool. For example, the pool table, the hockey game , and the poker table. Another plus of this stay is the rooms were massive. Also, the area was amazing very quiet and all you hear is the nature. I definitely recommend this to any one out there if you looking for a wonderful stay with friend or family members. Definitely one of the best ones I’ve been. Thank you Edward for allowing my family and I stay at your place. We made incredible memories.

name: Kristin
text: A beautiful home for our large family gathering! We had 12 people from babies to older folks and all of us had a terrific time. The pool was fun and we made a fun drink and ice cream station by the grill. Lots of seating and fun decor! The downside was quite a few packages arrived while we were there, but I had a nice conversation about this inconvenience with the host who was extremely responsive and kind. There was a beautiful waterfall nearby and even though the house is "in the woods" there are stores nearby which was very convenient. We would definitely come back and def recommend!

name: Cynthia
text:
My group and I had a fantastic weekend stay! The amenities were as described/listed and such a fantastic addition to the house. We spent the whole day at the pool and in the sauna.

Edward and his team were extremely responsive and answered any questions that we might’ve had in a very timely manner. He even got coffee and sugar delivered to the house quickly when we mentioned that it was out.

Our group would definitely come and stay again. Our only complaint is that we weren’t able to stay longer.

name: Michael
text:
Celebrated our son's first birthday here with our whole extended family and it was an amazing, fun and peaceful place for kids and adults. We're pretty picky about places we stay and for this one there was not a dull moment or suggested improvement to speak of.

The space is amazing and so are the hosts. They replied to every message faster than expected for a Sunday after 4th of July. Def worth the trip, the only thing I'd change about this trip was that I wish we could've stayed a bit longer. Keep up the great work 😊

name: Jose
text:
We had an amazing stay and couldn’t have asked for a better place to spend the weekend celebrating our friends’ birthday. The home was beautiful, clean, and thoughtfully set up, making it perfect for a large group.

The outdoor space was definitely the highlight of our trip. We spent hours enjoying the pool and relaxing outside, and it was clear that a lot of care went into creating such an inviting space. It gave everyone the chance to unwind, have fun, and make great memories together.

The host was responsive and accommodating throughout our stay, and everything was exactly as described. We would absolutely recommend this home to anyone looking for a great place to stay and would gladly book again in the future!

name: Madeline
text: very communicative and flexible host. the space was amazing for my large family and we had plenty of space and the amenities were perfect!! i would totally recommend!

name: Jessica
text: Great stay, wonderful amenities and very clean!

name: Marissa
text: We loved this house so much! It was beautiful and all of the extra amenities made our stay that much better. Everything was clean and Eddie was a great host. Super responsive and helpful whenever we needed anything. Would absolutely stay here again!

name: Jared
text: Edward was a great host and was great at responding during our stay. Simple rules, simple close out, great stay 10/10 would come back.

name: Ethan
text: The house was perfect, great for a group of 16!

name: Regis
text: The place was great for our group of guys. Rooms were clean and comfortable. We really enjoyed the pool table, bbq, hot tub, and poker room. We went in late May and so the pool was still a bit cold. In terms of the house, it does seem they’re in the process of renovating the place in some areas.

name: Mel
text: Great place for our group trip! We really enjoyed the amenities, had lots of space to spread out and enjoy our time in the house. Super quiet and peaceful area. Well stocked with necessities for a comfy stay.

name: Jose
text:
The stay with my fiancé and family was AMAZING! Some bathrooms were unclean, and there were some issues with silverware (dishes, and unkept cleanliness of home) upon arrival. However, the amenities - days spent - and overall quality of the Airbnb was PHENOMINAL. I would say the price should be lowered a bit when the house is not up to tier. Especially considering a GUEST in my group had to clean the (pool)&(hot tub)&(unclean bathrooms). Furthermore, the stay was great! Would I do this specific place again? Likely no. But it’s more of the Airbnb needing GUEST to perfect it up, when it should have been as such given the OWNER implied there will not be an early check in or late check out due to cleaning needing to be completed. So out of /10 …. (7) is a FAIR rating. Thank you for a good time!

Kind regards,
J.M & M.R ❤️

name: Jackson
text: Fantastic rental - would definitely rent again if possible. Beds were nice and there was a lot of great outdoor space. We liked the hot tub and the fire too.

name: Shota
text: Good location, clean space, and smooth check-in. Everything went well

name: Hector
text: The house was very spacious and The host was very responsive and attentive. We’re definitely looking forward to booking again!

name: Ande
text: We had an amazing weekend with our group of 12! More than enough to do in the house and in the area. Would recommend and o/or come back!

name: Aaron
text:
We enjoyed our stay immensely! The home was clean and the amenities were fantastic! The hot tub and sauna were incredible! Adults and children alike had a great time. Highly recommended!
Eddie was a fantastic host!

name: Alexandra
text: My family really enjoyed our stay here. We had a large group and there was plenty of space for everyone to spread out and relax or get together and socialize as we saw fit. I am unsure if luxury is a proper description of this house. It's definitely spacious and a very cool space, but it also felt like some TLC was needed. Wallpaper was peeling along all of the seams, the front door and walkway was in need of maintenance, and basement theater was musty. We also had a rough night with the HVAC system until we methodically followed the instructions to fix the system. In summary: a cool house and we settled in to really enjoy it, but didn't quite meet my expectations for a luxury experience.

name: Amanda
text: My family and I were there over NYE and it was perfect for the 15 of us. Lots of space. Enjoyed the bar room with the game table a lot. We had a great stay at this house. Skied at Camelback- only 30 minutes away. Overall a great trip.

name: Daniel
text: We had 10 guests for this trip ever one was happy and enjoyed the house.

name: Brooke
text: Edward was such a responsive host and really made us feel at home. I would recommend to anybody. Great stay!

name: Tayesha
text: Great stay! The place was clean, comfortable, and exactly as described. Would happily stay again

name: Ty
text: Everyone in my group said they had a great time and so did I, I would recommend

name: Miguel
text: Great stay. Would recommend for big groups. Would definitely rebook during the summer time.

name: Imani
text: This place is everything and more, you are guaranteed to feel right at home…. The beds were comfy & the common areas were spotless…. We got to use the sauna & hot tub which also was amazing ! Edward provided all essentials we needed to complete this trip. My family & friends, would highly recommend staying. 3 nights wasn’t long enough … hopefully we’ll revisit again soon … (beautiful scenery & wildlife)

name: Lydia
text:
Absolutely incredible stay!! We had a large group and loved being able to sit everyone down for dinner at once and use both stoves/ovens AND the grill to cook. The sauna and hot tub were great amenities since it was a bit chilly, and we loved having the fire pit for s’mores at night! We came from different directions and there was plenty of parking, and the house was PERFECT for a night of karaoke and games. We loved how modern the bedrooms were, and having a bed for everyone in our party was so lovely! The house is a short drive to hiking, and easy to get to nearby towns while still offering lots of privacy. Eddie was a great communicator, and we had clear instructions throughout our trip.

Highly, highly recommend!! We’re already talking about coming back!! 😊

name: Elzbieta
text:
we just stayed at this beautiful place . very clean, a lot of things to do, exceptional sauna and nice hot tub.
Edward very helpful.

name: Jay
text: Stayed here with a bunch of friends. Nice place to unwind, the house is plenty of great amenities. Really enjoyed relaxing in the sauna and hot tub at night. Great place if you have a big group too.

name: Mitesh
text: We had a fantastic time at Edward’s place. Highly recommend others. Looking forward to making it a recurring stay with friends and family!

name: Alisher
text: We recently vacationed at this dacha and were absolutely delighted! The location is simply wonderful—quiet, peaceful, the air is fresh, and nature is all around. The house is clean and cozy, with everything you need for a comfortable stay: a well-equipped kitchen, fresh linens, and well-maintained grounds.

name: Sage
text: My friends and I had a lovely stay at the Wiki Villa for my 40th birthday. The house was exactly as described, with lots of room for a large group and so much to do. We loved making use of the sauna, hot tub, pool, kitchen, karaoke, fire pit, pool table, game room, etc. etc. It was the perfect place to bring so many people together to celebrate over a long weekend. Thank you so much Edward!

name: Dezzy
text: Edward was super responsive throughout our entire stay. There was a small leak in a bathroom that was previously there but Edward was quick to respond and provide an alternative solution. The place was beautiful. I plan on staying again. Thank you Edward!

name: Celeste
text: We enjoyed our stay for our company end of summer outing. The place was a perfect getaway for our group that live in a busy city. So peaceful and relaxing with all the amenities. Thank you to Eddie who is very responsive too.

name: Karen
text: We had a wonderful time at Edward’s house! Edward was very responsive to all our questions and fast in getting us anything that was missing/needed ie kettle. There were 3 large fridges for us to store all our food and drinks. There were enough TV (living-room, game room, kitchen, bedrooms) for different groups to watch different movies at night. The kids enjoyed the game room and the adults enjoy the sauna and the hot tub. Due to weather we were only able to use the pool for a little bit but overall we had a lot of fun!

name: Lauren
text: Eddie was awesome. Super communicative and helpful with anything we needed. The house is terrific! We had a group of 12 and there was more than enough space for us all. The house is well-equipped with many thoughtful touches. We loved the pool (big enough for swimming laps!) and the lot is beautiful. We saw deer every day. A wonderful trip- we would not hesitate to return in the future!

name: Nicholas
text: Eddie was responsive before, during, and after our stay. The house was exactly as described, and exceeded our expectations. I would definitely stay again.

name: Michael
text: Great place to stay for a guys golf weekend. Close to all golf courses

name: Crystal
text:
Overall , it was a great stay. There is enough space and seating to spread out with my 20 person family . The kids love the large pool. We especially enjoyed all the common spaces and the multiple refrigerators, strong a/c, and WiFi and lastly a beautiful house and yard!
We would stay again :)

name: Muhsen
text: Lovely place, beautiful neighborhood, quiet and private.

name: Romell
text: Eddie has been very straight forward, welcoming, and attentive from the start of the booking process. He answer all of our questions and made sure we had everything we needed. If my group wants to return to the Poconos we will for sure contact Eddie and return to any of his listings.

name: Matthew
text: Eddie’s place was great and he was very responsive. Would definitely go back again in the future!

name: Saleh
text:
I had an amazing stay at this Airbnb! The place was exactly as described—clean, stylish, and very comfortable. The host was incredibly responsive and helpful throughout the entire trip, making check-in and check-out super easy. The location was perfect close to everything but still quiet and peaceful at night. I especially appreciated the thoughtful touches like extra towels, coffee, and local recommendations. I would absolutely stay here again and highly recommend it to anyone visiting the area
Definitely will trouble Book again

name: Laura
text:
Edward was a pleasure to communicate with, from the questions prior to reservations to answering questions as they came up right through the end of our trip.
He was extremely responsive and very kind.
The place was exactly what we were looking for!! Would definitely rent from him again!!

name: Lourdes
text: The house is beautiful, we have a great time ! 100% recommended:)

name: Crystal
text: Everything was excellent. We loved the house and all its details. Perfect for the whole family and delighted with all the variety they have for the children. We would rent it again without a doubt.

name: Sameer
text: We had five families visit this place and loved every bit of it. The house was great, rustic and cozy, with ton of features to make use of. Eddie is a great host and was quick to respond to our queries in a detailed manner. With slightly chilly weather we were not able to use the pool, but numerous other features kept us busy. Thank you Eddie for hosting us!

name: Gavin
text: Great stay with easy access and much space

name: Wai
text: We were a family of 13 and we all enjoyed our stay. The house has many amenities to do that you won't be bored during bad weather days. Having elevator in the house was great for our seniors especially with transferring their belongings. Supermarkets and quick eats was within 10 minutes from the house. We would love to return during the summer to use the pool and sauna. Thank you for creating a memorable and happy stay for us!

name: Erin
text: I loved this place so much and will definitely be back. I felt so at home and we had the best time. Eddie was an extraordinary host and the place is simply perfect. My dog was so happy she didn’t want to leave (and she is never happy when not at home). Thanks so much, Eddie! See you again one day!

name: Erika
text: Edward was very professional and responds immedietly

name: Matthew
text: Perfect for our large group of 11! Tons of space, comfortable rooms, and great common areas. Eddie was a fantastic host.

name: Luset
text: Beautiful property with lots of amenities! Was definitely once in a lifetime experience and I felt right at home! Thank you again!

name: James
text: Was a great stay to reconnect with some old friends!

name: Miriah
text:
As 4 families, we were all very happy with our experience! The home was spacious, well-designed, and had everything we needed for a comfortable and enjoyable stay.

The kitchen and dining area were a highlight—There was plenty of space for multiple people to cook at once, and the dining setup was perfect for our large group. The living room was another favorite spot, with its tall ceilings, big-screen TV, and enough space for all 14 of us to relax together.

The outdoor space was also great for walking around, though we arrived after snow followed by rain, so everything was covered in thick ice. Thankfully, the host had left six large bags of road salt, which made things much safer. The sauna was warm and relaxing. The hot tub, was fantastic.

For entertainment, the basement movie theater was a hit with the kids, and the pool table and game room. The beds were soft and cozy, making for a great night’s sleep.

Overall, everything was as described, and we had a wonderful stay.

name: Elizabeth
text: The home fit our large family and was really an enjoyable experience. We all got to be together under the same roof and enjoy good old fashion fun, watching movies and playing games. The kitchen was large so we could cook very easily and move freely. Had a great time away from home.

name: Darin
text: Loved the Entire Home!! Will definitely stay here again.

name: Jessie
text: Had a great stay at Edward’s. Expectations and amenities were spot on. Would highly recommend for large groups.

name: Paulina
text: Edward was very easy to chat with, responded very quick. My family and I had a great time! It was spacious and very peaceful. Definitely recommend and will be back. Thank you

name: Sydney
text: This airbnb was beautiful and very clean. Movie room is great and tons of games and things to do without leaving the property. The hot tub and sauna was a hit with my group. We recommend staying here and will do soon again. The host was extremely kind and helpful. He has this property very well maintained. We had a wonderful time.

name: Anabel
text: The house is beautiful and is very clean. The place in which it is located could not be better and the landscapes are amazing and Eddie is great. We would love to return! Thanks Eddie!

name: Laura
text: Great spot for a large group, Edward was wonderful at communicating!

name: April
text: Our group had a great time!!! There were lots of things to do.

name: Kevin
text: Wonderful winter get away with friends and family. The accommodations were perfect for a mid-sized group and the amenities met our expectations. Thank you Edward!

name: Aneesa
text: House was very big, the roads are dark coming around be careful, everyone enjoyed theirselves.. Thank you for helping me making my son 16th birthday a blast💜

name: Rhonika
text: We thoroughly enjoyed ourselves at the Wiki Villa! The home was very spacious and had plenty of rooms and bathrooms for a large group. The decor was our favorite part about the house and we appreciated how much time Eddie has put in the home. Eddie was also very responsive and helpful. I would recommend this home to anyone who is visiting the area!

name: Cody
text: Our group of 16 celebrated here for my partner's birthday. The space was absolutely perfect for a group of our size, very clean, and had plenty of amenities to keep our group comfortable and occupied! We'd love to return in the summer and make use of the pool in season. Eddie our host was very responsive and helpful the entire weekend. Looking forward to our return.

name: Yinglan
text: It’s was a great experience with Eddie’s house. The house was really beautiful and lots of things can do. It’s very nice for group of family and conference. Eddie is very nice person, kindly , friendly and very quick response to my questions. We will definitely comeback.

name: Lina
text: The house was fantastic! It was super clean, comfortable, well equipped, and the location was beautiful. Edward was a very accommodating and friendly host. We had a fantastic time. The house was perfect for kids, with plenty of space and a huge private backyard. Thank you for sharing your place with us, we are definetely willing to return.

name: Joseph
text: House was as advertised. Great space for a large group with plenty to do. Would love to come back and would recommend highly.

name: Zoe
text: Great place for a large group with plenty of roomy bedrooms and amenities. Our group was celebrating a milestone birthday and the house was equipped with everything we needed for cooking, entertaining, and maintaining the space. The house and surrounding property provided the perfect mix of communal spaces to come together and privacy for everyone to do their own thing throughout the trip. Our guests were already asking when we could all come back as we were packing up, so needless to say we would stay again!

name: Ali
text: Eddie's place was the perfect spot to host my friends and I for a milestone birthday. We made good use of the spacious living room, pool table, dining table and the sauna. The living space was comfortable and I loved how the house was decorated. I would recommend to anyone.

name: Nthabeleng
text: My friends and I loved this place! The pictures don’t do it justice. The different themes in each room were such a great touch. Plenty of space for the entire group and peaceful surroundings. The fire pit was our favorite since it was cold. Thank you Eddie for being a great host and being so quick to assist when we needed anything. Great place!

name: Lyss
text: So many bedrooms! All very clean and decorated nicely. sauna hot tub and pool were perfect for a peaceful getaway not far from home.

name: Anayeli
text: Edward was extremely helpful when my group and I had questions. He was quick to respond and was on top of things. We had the best time at the house it had a lit bit of everything which our group enjoyed. Location is perfect

name: Abdulla
text: I recently stayed at Edward's Airbnb and had a wonderful experience. The space was impeccably clean and well-maintained, which made our stay very comfortable. Edward was a fantastic host—responsive, helpful, and attentive to our needs. I highly recommend Edward’s place for anyone looking for a great stay. Thank you, Edward, for being such a gracious host!

name: Sharon
text: Our crew had a beautiful getaway with lots of laughs and good food! Everything was just perfect! Eddie was responsive and gave us thorough instructions. The pool was amazing! Lots of floaties for their 9ft pool! (3-4 ft also! Don’t get scared lol) Grill was great! Showers were yummy! Kitchen was well stocked! Game room was dope! The pool table is what sold us! We’ll be back soon!

name: Michael
text: The property is a fantastic weekend getaway with lots to do for any group of people. Its convenience to Shawnee Golf Inn made it perfect for our golf trip, and either way we could have never left the house and still be thoroughly entertained all weekend. Eddie was very responsive and quick to help with answers to any questions. Would definitely book again!

name: Anjolee
text: Edward was very responsive to any questions we had while staying at the property. The property was a perfect private getaway to spend time catching up with friends. The pool/sauna/hot tub were great for sunny days, and the indoor amenities and large space were perfect to enjoy our stay on rainy days. The Property was 5-10 minutes away from any grocery needs while there. It is a great place to visit with a group of people. The shared spaces were large, and the private spaces were great when a recharge was needed. A king bed in every room is a plus. Some guests in our group worked remote and said they had no issues with the wifi the entire time.

name: Vanessa
text: We had a small family getaway in the Poconos. Edward's home was very well-kept. Our kids enjoyed the pool, nice and big. The house looked exactly as the description mentioned. Edward's communication was excellent--always responsive and very friendly. Overall, our family had a great time. Thanks for everything !

name: Kristie
text: This space was perfect to accommodate my friends and family for my 1 year wedding anniversary! I would definitely come back again!

name: Emil
text: Amazing house! The sauna is a huge plus, and the pool is lovely.

name: Marie
text: it was a very clean house, we had a lot of fun there!

name: Miracle
text: My family and I enjoyed our stay at this lovely property. Edward was a good host. Very straight forward and responsive. Check in was a breeze and the area was peaceful. The home is very spacious and there is something for everyone to do. I will be booking again.

name: Adam
text: Enjoyable location - host very helpful and good communication

name: Josh
text: Edward's house was a great place for a gathering of friends. Between the fire pit, pool, hot tub, sauna, excellent kitchen, and other amenities, my group felt no need to leave the house. The home is generally secluded and private. We had a small issue with the kitchen sink but Edward was immediately responsive. I would definitely stay here again.

name: Henry
text: great clean place for big groups in a wonderful beautiful wooded location

name: Ashley
text: Edward’s home was absolutely fantastic. We had so much fun here, with so many activities. The pool wasn’t open when we booked our stay, but I would ask when he opens it. The space was great, the view, the activities were absolutely amazing. Someone took the poker chips so we had to buy our own. Other than that everything was perfect!

name: Michaela
text: Edward’s home was beautiful and looked exactly as it did in the photos. Our group had a great time, and would definitely go back a bit later in the spring/summer so we can use the pool next time. Other than the listed features/amenities, there were also board games, yard games, and a fully stocked kitchen. Edward was very responsive and friendly, as well.

name: Giselle
text: Beautiful clean home with beautiful amenities. We really enjoyed our stay. Host was very welcoming and fast to respond to questions. Home is as beautiful as pictured and very spacious near the major poconos attractions

name: Murad
text: Our stay at this beautifully located Airbnb villa was nothing short of perfect. Tucked away in a serene, exclusive area, the villa offered complete privacy. The amenities were well-maintained and luxurious, making our stay comfortable and enjoyable. From the modern kitchen to the plush bedrooms and landscaped outdoor spaces, every detail was thoughtfully curated. Highly recommend for a peaceful retreat.

name: Abe
text: Was an amazing experience. Edward was fast in responding to my questions. Home was beautiful spacious and had everything we needed.
